allowCreate.zh-CN: 是否允许创建下拉列表中不存在的条目，需配合 `filter` 使用。创建时触发 `onCreate`，创建项的内容可用 `renderCreateItem` 自定义。
allowCreate.en-US: Whether items missing from the list can be created, used together with `filter`. `onCreate` fires on creation, and `renderCreateItem` customizes the created item.

aria-label.zh-CN: combobox 的可访问名称，优先级低于 `aria-labelledby`，高于 `insetLabel`。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the combobox. It takes precedence over `insetLabel`, and `aria-labelledby` takes precedence over it.

arrowIcon.zh-CN: 自定义右侧下拉箭头图标。`showClear` 开启且有已选值时，hover 会优先显示清除图标。
arrowIcon.en-US: Custom dropdown arrow icon on the right. With `showClear` on and a value selected, hovering shows the clear icon first.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 弹出层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the dropdown flips its direction automatically when it is covered.

autoClearSearchValue.zh-CN: 同时开启 `multiple` 与 `filter` 时，选中选项后是否自动清空搜索关键字。
autoClearSearchValue.en-US: With both `multiple` and `filter` on, whether the search keyword is cleared after an option is selected.

autoFocus.zh-CN: 初始渲染时是否自动聚焦。
autoFocus.en-US: Whether the Select is focused on the initial render.

borderless.en-US: Whether to use the borderless style.

children.zh-CN: 选项，直接子元素须为 `Select.Option` 或 `Select.OptGroup`，Fragment 会被展开。传入 `optionList` 时以 `optionList` 为准，忽略 children。
children.en-US: Options. Direct children must be `Select.Option` or `Select.OptGroup`, and fragments are expanded. When `optionList` is passed, it is used and children are ignored.

className.zh-CN: 类名，应用于触发器根元素。
className.en-US: Class name, applied to the trigger root element.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，`showClear` 为 `true` 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom icon of the clear button, effective when `showClear` is `true`.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 下拉列表已展开时，再次点击选择框是否收起下拉列表。
clickToHide.en-US: When the dropdown is open, whether clicking the Select again closes the dropdown.

defaultActiveFirstOption.zh-CN: 没有选中值时是否默认高亮第一个未禁用的选项，按回车可直接选中。已有选中值时，打开下拉列表会高亮第一个已选的选项。
defaultActiveFirstOption.en-US: Whether the first enabled option is highlighted when nothing is selected, so Enter selects it directly. When a value is selected, opening the dropdown highlights the first selected option.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 是否默认展开下拉列表。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the dropdown is open by default.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 初始选中的值，用于非受控模式。多选时为数组。
defaultValue.en-US: Initially selected value, for uncontrolled use. An array in multiple mode.

dropdownMatchSelectWidth.zh-CN: 下拉菜单的最小宽度是否与选择框相同。宽度本身不会被写死，需要固定宽度时用 `dropdownStyle`。
dropdownMatchSelectWidth.en-US: Whether the minimum width of the dropdown matches the Select. The width itself is not fixed; use `dropdownStyle` to set a fixed width.

dropdownStyle.zh-CN: 弹出层的样式，例如用 `width` 自定义弹出层的宽度。
dropdownStyle.en-US: Style of the dropdown, for example `width` to set its width.

ellipsisTrigger.zh-CN: 同时设置 `maxTagCount` 且为多选时，是否对溢出的标签做自适应处理，宽度不足时截断最后一个标签的内容。开启后有一定性能损耗，大表单场景不推荐使用。
ellipsisTrigger.en-US: With `maxTagCount` set in multiple mode, whether overflowing tags adapt to the width, truncating the last tag when space runs short. It costs some performance, so it is not recommended for large forms.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 无结果时展示的内容。未设置时展示语言包中的空状态文案；设为 `null` 时下拉列表不展示任何内容。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown when there are no results. When unset, the locale's empty text is shown; `null` shows nothing in the dropdown.

expandRestTagsOnClick.zh-CN: 同时设置 `maxTagCount` 且为多选时，下拉列表展开期间是否展示全部剩余标签。
expandRestTagsOnClick.en-US: With `maxTagCount` set in multiple mode, whether all remaining tags are shown while the dropdown is open.

filter.zh-CN: 是否可搜索。传入 `true` 时按选项的 `label` 是否包含输入值筛选；传入函数时，函数接收输入值与选项对象，返回 `true` 表示保留该选项。
filter.en-US: Whether the Select is searchable. `true` filters by whether the option label contains the input. A function receives the input value and the option, and returns `true` to keep it.

id.zh-CN: 触发器的 id，选项的 id 由它派生。未传时由组件生成。
id.en-US: Id of the trigger. Option ids are derived from it. Generated by the component when unset.

innerBottomSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉列表内部底部的自定义内容，随选项列表滚动，滚动到底部时展示。
innerBottomSlot.en-US: Custom content rendered at the bottom inside the option list. It scrolls with the list and shows when the list is scrolled to the bottom.

innerTopSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉列表内部顶部的自定义内容，随选项列表滚动，滚动到顶部时展示。
innerTopSlot.en-US: Custom content rendered at the top inside the option list. It scrolls with the list and shows when the list is scrolled to the top.

inputProps.zh-CN: `filter` 为 `true` 时搜索输入框的额外属性，可用属性参考 Input 组件。不要传入 `value`、`ref`、`onChange`、`onFocus`，否则会覆盖 Select 的回调，影响组件行为。
inputProps.en-US: Extra props of the search input when `filter` is `true`; see the Input component for the available props. Do not pass `value`, `ref`, `onChange` or `onFocus`, which would override the Select's handlers and break its behavior.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 选择框内的内嵌标签，同时作为 combobox 与下拉列表的名称来源。设置了 `prefix` 时不渲染，也不作名称。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label inside the trigger, also the name source of the combobox and the listbox. It is not rendered and is not used as the name when `prefix` is set.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: `insetLabel` 元素的 id，combobox 的 `aria-labelledby` 指向它。未传时由组件生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: Id of the `insetLabel` element, which the `aria-labelledby` of the combobox points to. Generated by the component when unset.

loading.zh-CN: 下拉列表是否展示加载动画。加载中不展示选项。
loading.en-US: Whether the dropdown shows a loading spinner. Options are hidden while loading.

max.zh-CN: 最多可选的数量，仅多选时生效。超出后无法再选中该选项，并触发 `onExceed`。
max.en-US: Maximum number of selectable options, effective in multiple mode only. Options beyond it cannot be selected, and `onExceed` fires.

maxHeight.zh-CN: 下拉菜单中选项列表的最大高度。使用虚拟化且 `virtualize.height` 大于默认的 270px 时，需将它设为相同的值，以避免出现双滚动条。
maxHeight.en-US: Maximum height of the option list in the dropdown. With virtualization and `virtualize.height` above the default 270px, set it to the same value to avoid a double scrollbar.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 多选时，超过该数量的已选项以 `+N` 的形式展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: In multiple mode, selected items beyond this count are shown as `+N`.

onBlur.zh-CN: 失去焦点时的回调。点击外部关闭已展开的下拉列表时，参数为该次 mousedown 的原生事件。
onBlur.en-US: Callback when the Select loses focus. When a click outside closes the open dropdown, the argument is that mousedown's native event.

onChange.zh-CN: 值变化时的回调。单选时入参为 `T | undefined`，多选时为 `T[]`；`onChangeWithObject` 为 `true` 时入参为选项对象。
onChange.en-US: Callback when the value changes. The argument is `T | undefined` in single mode and `T[]` in multiple mode, or the option object when `onChangeWithObject` is `true`.

onChangeWithObject.zh-CN: 是否将选项的其他属性随 `onChange` 回传。设为 `true` 后，`onChange` 的入参为 `{ value, label, ...rest }` 形式的对象，`value` 与 `defaultValue` 也应为带有 `value`、`label` 键的对象。
onChangeWithObject.en-US: Whether the other properties of the option are passed to `onChange`. When `true`, `onChange` receives an object such as `{ value, label, ...rest }`, and `value` and `defaultValue` should also be objects with `value` and `label` keys.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Callback when the clear button is clicked.

onCreate.zh-CN: `allowCreate` 为 `true` 时，创建备选项的回调，参数为新建的选项。
onCreate.en-US: Callback when an option is created with `allowCreate` on. The argument is the created option.

onDeselect.zh-CN: 取消选中时的回调，仅多选时有效。第一个参数为选项的原始 value，第二个参数为选项对象。
onDeselect.en-US: Callback when an option is deselected, in multiple mode only. The first argument is the original option value, and the second is the option object.

onDropdownVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉列表展开或收起时的回调，参数为下拉列表是否可见。
onDropdownVisibleChange.en-US: Callback when the dropdown opens or closes, receiving whether it is visible.

onExceed.zh-CN: 选中数量超过 `max` 时的回调，仅多选时生效，参数为被拒绝选中的选项。
onExceed.en-US: Callback when the selection would exceed `max`, in multiple mode only. The argument is the option that was rejected.

onFocus.en-US: Callback when the Select gets focus.

onListScroll.zh-CN: 选项列表滚动时的回调。
onListScroll.en-US: Callback when the option list scrolls.

onMouseEnter.zh-CN: 鼠标移入选择框时的回调。
onMouseEnter.en-US: Callback when the mouse enters the Select.

onMouseLeave.zh-CN: 鼠标移出选择框时的回调。
onMouseLeave.en-US: Callback when the mouse leaves the Select.

onSearch.zh-CN: 搜索输入内容变化时的回调。第一个参数为输入值，第二个参数为引起变化的事件；通过 ref 的 `search` 方法或 `triggerRender` 触发时，第二个参数为 `undefined`。
onSearch.en-US: Callback when the search input changes. The first argument is the input value, and the second is the event that caused the change. It is `undefined` when triggered through the ref `search` method or `triggerRender`.

onSelect.zh-CN: 选中时的回调。第一个参数总是选项的原始 value，开启 `onChangeWithObject` 时也是；第二个参数为选项对象。
onSelect.en-US: Callback when an option is selected. The first argument is always the original option value, even with `onChangeWithObject`, and the second is the option object.

optionList.zh-CN: 以数组形式传入选项，每个对象须包含 `value` 与 `label`，其他属性也会随选项回传。
optionList.en-US: Options as an array. Each item needs `value` and `label`; its other properties are passed back with the option.

outerBottomSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉弹出层底部、与选项列表平级的自定义内容，无论选项列表是否滚动都会展示。
outerBottomSlot.en-US: Custom content rendered at the bottom of the dropdown, beside the option list. It stays visible whether or not the list scrolls.

outerTopSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉弹出层顶部、与选项列表平级的自定义内容，无论选项列表是否滚动都会展示。
outerTopSlot.en-US: Custom content rendered at the top of the dropdown, beside the option list. It stays visible whether or not the list scrolls.

placeholder.zh-CN: 未选中任何选项时显示的文字。
placeholder.en-US: Text shown when no option is selected.

position.zh-CN: 菜单展开的位置，可选值与 Tooltip 的 `position` 相同。未设置时，从左到右的文本方向下为 `bottomLeft`，从右到左的文本方向下为 `bottomRight`。
position.en-US: Position of the dropdown, with the same values as the Tooltip `position`. When unset, it is `bottomLeft` in left-to-right text and `bottomRight` in right-to-left text.

prefix.zh-CN: 选择框的前缀，可以是文本或 ReactNode。文本与图标会自动带上左右间隔，自定义节点的左右间隔为 0。
prefix.en-US: Prefix of the trigger, as text or a ReactNode. Text and icons get automatic side spacing, while custom nodes get none.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 通过 `focus` 方法聚焦时，是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示被聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing through the `focus` method prevents the browser from scrolling the document to show the focused element.

ref.zh-CN: 指向 `SelectHandle` 句柄，通过它调用下方 Methods 中的方法。
ref.en-US: Points to the `SelectHandle`, whose methods are listed in Methods below.

remote.zh-CN: 是否为远程搜索。为 `true` 时输入内容变化后不再对当前选项做本地筛选，需由外部通过更新 `optionList` 提供结果。
remote.en-US: Whether search is remote. When `true`, input changes skip local filtering, so the results must be supplied by updating `optionList`.

renderCreateItem.zh-CN: `allowCreate` 为 `true` 时，自定义创建条目的内容，参数为 `(inputValue, isFocus, style)`，返回 ReactNode。未设置时展示语言包中的「创建」加输入内容。与虚拟化结合使用时，须把 `style` 用在自定义节点上。
renderCreateItem.en-US: Custom content of the create item when `allowCreate` is `true`, called with `(inputValue, isFocus, style)`. When unset, it shows the locale's create text followed by the input. With virtualization, apply `style` to the custom node.

renderOptionItem.zh-CN: 完全接管下拉列表中候选项的渲染。参数包括 `id`、`value`、`label`、`selected`、`focused`、`disabled`、`inputValue`、`className`、`style`、`onClick` 与 `onMouseEnter`。`style`、`className`、`onClick` 与 `onMouseEnter` 须用在包装元素上，`id` 须与 `role="option"`、`aria-selected`、`aria-disabled` 一起写在包装元素上。
renderOptionItem.en-US: Takes over the rendering of each candidate option. The arguments include `id`, `value`, `label`, `selected`, `focused`, `disabled`, `inputValue`, `className`, `style`, `onClick` and `onMouseEnter`. Apply `style`, `className`, `onClick` and `onMouseEnter` to the wrapper element, and write `id` on it together with `role="option"`, `aria-selected` and `aria-disabled`.

renderSelectedItem.zh-CN: 自定义选择框中已选项标签的渲染。单选时入参为选项对象，返回 ReactNode；多选时入参为选项对象与 `{ index, disabled, onClose }`，返回 `{ isRenderInTag, content }`，`isRenderInTag` 为 `true` 时，`content` 会包在带背景色与关闭按钮的标签中。
renderSelectedItem.en-US: Custom rendering of the selected item in the trigger. In single mode it receives the option object and returns a ReactNode. In multiple mode it receives the option object and `{ index, disabled, onClose }`, and returns `{ isRenderInTag, content }`; when `isRenderInTag` is `true`, `content` is wrapped in a tag with a background and a close button.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: `showRestTagsPopover` 开启时，超出标签的 Popover 配置，可设置 `position`、`trigger` 等，参考 Popover 组件。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Popover props for the overflowing tags when `showRestTagsPopover` is on, such as `position` and `trigger`. See the Popover component.

searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 搜索框位于下拉列表中（`searchPosition` 为 `dropdown`）时，搜索框的占位文字。
searchPlaceholder.en-US: Placeholder of the search input when it is in the dropdown, that is, when `searchPosition` is `dropdown`.

searchPosition.zh-CN: `filter` 开启时搜索框的位置。`trigger` 表示搜索框在选择框内，`dropdown` 表示搜索框在下拉列表顶部。搭配 `triggerRender` 使用可以实现更自由的交互。
searchPosition.en-US: Position of the search input when `filter` is on. `trigger` places it inside the Select, and `dropdown` places it at the top of the dropdown. Combined with `triggerRender`, it allows more flexible interaction.

showArrow.en-US: Whether the dropdown arrow is shown.

showClear.en-US: Whether the clear button is shown.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超过 `maxTagCount` 后，悬停到 `+N` 上时是否通过 Popover 展示剩余内容。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: When tags overflow `maxTagCount`, whether hovering over `+N` shows the remaining content in a Popover.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 `small`、`default`、`large`。未设置时为默认尺寸。
size.en-US: Size, one of `small`, `default` and `large`. The default size applies when unset.

spacing.zh-CN: 浮层与选择器之间的距离，单位为 px。传入 `{ x, y }` 对象时可分别设置水平与垂直距离。未设置时为 `8`。
spacing.en-US: Distance in px between the dropdown and the Select. An `{ x, y }` object sets the horizontal and vertical distances separately. It is `8` when unset.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click events on the dropdown stop propagating.

style.zh-CN: 样式，应用于触发器根元素。
style.en-US: Style, applied to the trigger root element.

suffix.zh-CN: 选择框的后缀，可以是文本或 ReactNode，规则与 `prefix` 相同。
suffix.en-US: Suffix of the trigger, as text or a ReactNode. The rules are the same as for `prefix`.

triggerRender.zh-CN: 自定义选择框的触发器。入参包括 `value`、`inputValue`、`onSearch`、`onRemove`、`onClear`、`disabled`、`placeholder` 与 `componentProps`。若想保留搜索能力又不自行渲染输入框，可同时把 `searchPosition` 设为 `dropdown`。
triggerRender.en-US: Custom trigger of the Select. Its arguments include `value`, `inputValue`, `onSearch`, `onRemove`, `onClear`, `disabled`, `placeholder` and `componentProps`. To keep search without rendering an input, set `searchPosition` to `dropdown` as well.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 `warning`、`error`、`default`，仅影响背景色等样式。未设置时为 `default`。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, one of `warning`, `error` and `default`. It only changes styles such as the background color. `default` applies when unset.

value.zh-CN: 当前选中的值。传入后 Select 为受控组件，需配合 `onChange` 使用。多选时为数组。
value.en-US: Selected value. Passing it makes the Select controlled, used together with `onChange`. An array in multiple mode.

virtualize.zh-CN: 开启列表虚拟化，用于大量选项时优化性能。包含 `height`（默认 270）、`width`（默认 `100%`）与 `itemSize`（每行选项的高度，必传）。
virtualize.en-US: Enables list virtualization for large option lists. It takes `height` (default 270), `width` (default `100%`) and `itemSize` (the height of each option row, required).

clearInput.en-US: Clears the value of the search input.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦选择框。可搜索时聚焦搜索框并展开下拉列表；不可搜索时只聚焦触发器，不展开下拉列表。
focus.en-US: Focuses the trigger, or the search input when the Select is searchable. The dropdown opens only when the Select is searchable.

rePosition.zh-CN: 按触发器当前位置立即重新计算下拉层位置。下拉层已随滚动、窗口尺寸变化、触发器移动以及触发器或列表的尺寸变化自动重新定位，一般无需调用；跟随触发器移动会晚一帧，需要同一帧内对齐时调用。
rePosition.en-US: Recomputes the dropdown position from the trigger's current position at once. The dropdown already follows scrolling, window resizing, trigger moves and size changes of the trigger or list, so this is rarely needed; following a trigger move lands a frame late, so call this to align within the same frame.

search.zh-CN: 按输入了该值来搜索，该值会被置给搜索框。不传事件时，`onSearch` 的第二个参数为 `undefined`。
search.en-US: Searches as if the value had been typed, and sets it into the search input. Without an event, the second argument of `onSearch` is `undefined`.

selectAll.zh-CN: 选中所有可见且未禁用的选项，仅多选时有效。
selectAll.en-US: Selects every visible, enabled option. Effective in multiple mode only.

children.zh-CN: 选项的内容。未设置 `label` 时作为展示的内容。
children.en-US: Content of the option. It is shown when `label` is unset.

current.zh-CN: 内部属性，由 AutoComplete 设置，标记该选项为当前项（`aria-selected`）。Select 的使用者无需设置。
current.en-US: Internal prop set by AutoComplete to mark the option as the current one (`aria-selected`). Select users do not need to set it.

label.zh-CN: 展示的文本，可以是字符串、数字或 ReactNode。渲染时优先取 `label`，未设置时依次取 `children` 与 `value`。
label.en-US: Displayed text, a string, a number or a ReactNode. Rendering prefers `label`, then falls back to `children` and then `value`.

showTick.zh-CN: 选中时是否展示 √ 图标。由 Select 渲染的选项默认展示。
showTick.en-US: Whether a check icon is shown when the option is selected. Options rendered by Select show it by default.

value.zh-CN: 选项的值。同一个 Select 内 `value` 不应重复，`label` 可以重复。
value.en-US: Value of the option. It should be unique within a Select, while `label` may repeat.

children.en-US: Options in the group, as `Select.Option` elements.

className.en-US: Class name of the group title.

label.zh-CN: 分组标题。设置后，分组内的选项位于以该标题命名的 `group` 中。
label.en-US: Title of the group. Options in the group sit in a `group` named by this title.
